implementation.storage: HOME-contained 0700 directories; atomic 0600 JSON records; 0600 lock and append-only JSONL audit
implementation.concurrency: thread lock plus fcntl process lock
record_contents: in-progress/completed state, outcome, HTTP status, duration
implementation.audit_contents: Allowlisted metadata only; no request body, operation arguments, bearer/CSRF/bootstrap tokens, or response payloads
implementation.replay_behavior: Conflict rejects changed payload; in-progress reports unknown outcome; completed duplicate is rejected without replaying response or mutation
implementation.adapter_policy: Mutation transport remains disabled by default and requires explicit allow_mutations plus an object declaring durable storage; adapter binds no socket
implementation.session_policy: Session credentials remain in-memory and expire on process restart
implementation.record_validation: Strict schema and private owner/mode; rejects JSON non-finite constants and timestamps outside 0..1e12 seconds

adt_shizuku_context.interpretation: The report distinguishes local ADB client/server port 5037 from the Android device transport. In the audited topology the custom Shizuku fork bootstraps the bridge after cold boot; standard Android Wireless Debugging is described as an alternative requiring manual pairing after reboot. Neither alternative has been qualified in the current Ternuxx runtime. No claim is made that enabling a local TCP listener alone reduces Shizuku dependency.

limitations: No HTTP socket/listener, browser, or on-device loopback test was run.
The durable store is a tested primitive and is not configured as the live adapter's production store.
Concurrent server worker and request deadline enforcement remain future listener requirements.
